data.long_meaning: The name Douglass originated from the Scottish Gaelic 'Dubhglas', which means 'dark stream' or 'black water'. Historically, the name was given to Scottish children born near a dark-colored river or stream. The name Douglass carries the meaning “Dark River” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. A child born near such a body of water was believed to be blessed with the strength and vitality of the river.
